policy: Nothing in this directory is tracked except this manifest. The curated JSONs under results/ are the source of truth for every reported number, and reproduce.sh verifies the paper from them alone and never reads this directory.

default_replay.description: The default replay recomputes or re-reads every frozen value from results/, runs the tests, audits MANIFEST.sha256 and runs a cpu twin-cone self-test.

assets.role: Swap-equilibrated N = 1500 parent configurations integrated by the configurational-entropy ladder
assets.reason: Regenerated by the equilibration driver; a binary snapshot adds no evidence beyond results/sc_energy_ladder/.

assets.role: Equilibrated flagship and ladder parents that the twin-cone campaigns branch from
assets.reason: Several GB of trajectory state per campaign.

assets.role: Per-former equilibration and cone archives behind the six-glass-former ceiling result
assets.reason: Several GB; the independent raw audit that re-derived every stored value from them ships as results/breadth/verification.json.

assets.role: Per-shard confined-film twin output that the merge consumes
assets.reason: Superseded by the merged artifact results/confinement/slab_cone_merged.json, which carries all 40 twin pairs individually.

production_settings: configs/campaigns.json records the arguments each driver was run with; every driver also documents itself, for example scripts/slab_cone_campaign.py --help.
